name: valuar-ai-coach
description: Analyze read-only Strava training data with ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect Strava and analyze recent training activities, GPS routes, heart rate, cadence, power, speed and elevation. ValuarAICoach is read-only and cannot modify or delete Strava activities.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my most recent cycling activity, including heart rate, power and cadence.
Compare my recent runs and identify changes in pace at a similar heart rate.
Show the GPS route and elevation profile of my latest outdoor activity.
